usedFor: Buffer holds your scheduled and sent social posts, and Microsoft Excel keeps the log through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Post Is Sent” in Buffer, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each sent post becomes a new table row, giving you a running record of what went out.

watchOut: “New Post Is Sent” in Buffer is polling, so rows appear after a scheduled check.
